name: Dollinger
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

The Hotel Dollinger is centrally located in the town of Westendorf in the Brixental. The surroundings are characterized by the Bergwelt der Kitzbüheler Alpen. The Ausstattung includes a wellness area with sauna and swimming pool, as well as several gastronomic units. The Atmosphäre corresponds to a traditional, Alpine-run family business. The guest structure consists mainly of Paaren und Familien. The valley station of the mountain railway is within walking distance from the hotel. The culinary offer focuses on Halbpension with regional highlights. Overall, the house offers a reliable infrastructure for sporting activities in summer and winter.
